services.title: Disinfection & Sanitation
services.summary: Professional-grade disinfection that eliminates 99.9% of bacteria, viruses, and pathogens from all surfaces.
services.description: Our disinfection and sanitation service uses hospital-grade EPA-approved solutions combined with electrostatic spraying technology to ensure complete coverage. We treat every surface — high-touch points, floors, ceilings, and HVAC vents — giving you a space that is not just clean but truly safe. Ideal for offices, healthcare facilities, schools, food establishments, and residential homes.

services.title: Pest Control Service
services.summary: Targeted elimination of cockroaches, rodents, termites, mosquitoes, bedbugs, and all common pests.
services.description: Swift Clear's integrated pest management begins with a thorough inspection to identify species, entry points, and infestation severity. We then apply targeted treatments — chemical, biological, or physical barriers depending on the situation — and provide a prevention plan to stop re-infestation. All chemicals used are child- and pet-safe when dry.

services.title: Basic Cleaning
services.summary: Routine surface cleaning, dusting, mopping, and sanitizing for a consistently tidy space.
services.description: Our basic cleaning covers all the essentials: dusting surfaces and furniture, wiping down countertops and appliances, vacuuming or sweeping floors, mopping, cleaning bathrooms, emptying bins, and tidying common areas. Perfect as a regular weekly or bi-weekly maintenance schedule to keep your home or office consistently presentable.

services.title: General Cleaning
services.summary: A thorough top-to-bottom clean covering every room, surface, and corner of your property.
services.description: Going beyond the basics, our general cleaning service addresses every room and surface in your property. Cleaners scrub tiles, clean inside appliances, wipe cabinet interiors, wash windows from inside, detail baseboards, and remove grime build-up in hard-to-reach areas. Recommended for monthly upkeep or before/after hosting events.

services.title: Post-Construction Cleaning
services.summary: Specialized removal of construction dust, debris, paint splatters, and residue after renovation or building work.
services.description: Construction leaves behind fine dust that infiltrates every crack, along with paint splatters, adhesive residue, and debris. Our post-construction team uses industrial-grade equipment — HEPA vacuums, grout cleaners, and solvents — to restore the space to move-in condition. We handle residential renovations, commercial fit-outs, and new builds.

services.title: Deep Cleaning
services.summary: Intensive fabric cleaning for carpets, rugs, couches, chairs, curtains, mattresses, and upholstery.
services.description: Our deep cleaning service targets embedded dirt, allergens, dust mites, pet dander, and stains inside fabrics and upholstery. Using hot-water extraction (steam cleaning) and professional dry-cleaning agents, we restore carpets, rugs, sofas, armchairs, curtains, and mattresses to near-original condition. Service includes pre-treatment of stubborn stains and a deodorizing finish.

services.title: Aircon Cleaning, Repair & Installation
services.summary: Full aircon service: cleaning, maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, and new unit installation.
services.description: A dirty or malfunctioning air conditioner wastes energy and circulates contaminants. Swift Clear's certified technicians clean filters, coils, drain pans, and blower fans; recharge refrigerant; diagnose electrical and mechanical issues; and perform full system installations for split-type, window-type, and cassette units. We service all major brands.

services.title: Decluttering Service
services.summary: Organized removal and proper disposal of unwanted items, junk, and clutter from any space.
services.description: Our decluttering team works with you to sort, categorize, and decide what stays, what gets donated, and what gets disposed of — responsibly. We haul away junk, arrange items logically, and can coordinate with recycling or donation centers. This service pairs perfectly with a deep clean or move-out clean to fully reset a space.

services.title: Floor Scrubbing, Polishing & Waxing
services.summary: Professional restoration and protection of all hard floor types: tiles, marble, wood, vinyl, and concrete.
services.description: Floors take the most abuse in any property. Our floor care service begins with heavy-duty scrubbing to strip old wax, stains, and embedded grime, followed by machine polishing to restore sheen, then a protective wax or sealant coat that repels dirt and makes future maintenance easier. We work on ceramic tile, marble, granite, hardwood, vinyl, and polished concrete.
